description: List the tarot spreads available for a reading, with each spread's id, name, tagline, number of cards, and position names, in the requested language. The ids are the values draw_cards accepts as spread_id and are the same in every language.

locale.description: Language for spread names, position names, card names and widget text: the language the user is writing in, as a BCP-47 code (zh-CN = Simplified Chinese, zh-TW = Traditional Chinese). Defaults to en.

name: list_spreads
title: List Tarot Spreads
